description: Each equipment status's average pulse rate is taken over all its signals, each signal weighted equally.

a.request: Match each signal to its telescope via `signals.telescref` = `telescopes.telescregistry`, and drop signals without a matching telescope. For each equipment status (`telescopes.equipstatus`), compute the average pulse rate (`signals.pulsepersec`), with each signal counting once, ignoring missing pulse rates. Take the mean of these status averages and keep the statuses whose average is above it, noting how far above each one is. Then take the mean of the kept statuses' averages and keep only the statuses whose average is above that second mean, again noting how far above each one is. Return one row with three values: the average pulse-rate average of the remaining statuses, their average excess over the first mean, and their average excess over the second mean. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) as status_avg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as first_mean_val FROM status_averages), above_first AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.status_avg, fm.first_mean_val FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN first_mean fm WHERE sa.status_avg > fm.first_mean_val), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as second_mean_val FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.equipstatus, af.status_avg, af.first_mean_val, sm.second_mean_val FROM above_first af CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE af.status_avg > sm.second_mean_val) SELECT AVG(status_avg) as final_avg, AVG(status_avg - first_mean_val) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(status_avg - second_mean_val) as avg_excess_over_second FROM above_second

c.request: Link each signal to its telescope (`signals.telescref` = `telescopes.telescregistry`), and drop signals with no matching telescope. For each equipment status (`telescopes.equipstatus`), what is the average pulse rate (`signals.pulsepersec`) of the telescopes in that status, based on the signals they detected and ignoring missing pulse rates? Keep the statuses whose average is above the mean of all the status averages, and note how far above it each one is. From those, keep only the statuses whose average is above the mean of the kept ones, again noting the excess. Give one row with three values: the average pulse rate of the final statuses, their average excess over the first mean, and their average excess over the second mean. Don't round. Each equipment status's average pulse rate is taken over all its signals, each signal weighted equally.
c.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    t.equipstatus,
    AVG(s.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_val
  FROM status_averages
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.equipstatus,
    sa.avg_pulse_rate,
    sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_val as excess_over_first
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_val
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_val
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.equipstatus,
    ff.avg_pulse_rate,
    ff.excess_over_first,
    ff.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_val as excess_over_second
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
  WHERE ff.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as final_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(excess_over_first) as avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(excess_over_second) as avg_excess_over_second
FROM second_filter

d.request: For each equipment status, calculate the average pulse rate of its signals (equally weighted); identify statuses above the mean of all status averages (recording excess), then further identify which are above the mean of those identified (recording excess); return the final average pulse rate and the two average excesses.
d.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    t.equipstatus,
    AVG(s.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_value FROM status_averages
),
first_excess_group AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.avg_pulse_rate,
    (sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_value) as excess
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_value
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_value FROM first_excess_group
),
second_excess_group AS (
  SELECT 
    feg.avg_pulse_rate,
    (feg.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_value) as excess
  FROM first_excess_group feg
  CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
  WHERE feg.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_value
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM second_excess_group) as final_average_pulse_rate,
  (SELECT AVG(excess) FROM first_excess_group) as first_average_excess,
  (SELECT AVG(excess) FROM second_excess_group) as second_average_excess

b.request: Join signals to their matching telescopes and drop unmatched; for each equipment status, calculate the mean pulse rate of signals detected by that status (each signal weighted equally, excluding nulls); filter to keep statuses with mean above the mean of all status-means and calculate their excess; from those kept, further filter to keep statuses with mean above the mean of the kept statuses and calculate their excess; return one row with three unrounded values: the mean pulse rate of the final-kept statuses, the average excess of those statuses over the first threshold, and the average excess of those statuses over the second threshold.
b.sql: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT s.signalregistry, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, s.pulsepersec FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry), status_means AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as mean_pulse_rate FROM joined_data WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipstatus), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_pulse_rate) as overall_mean FROM status_means), first_filtered AS (SELECT equipstatus, mean_pulse_rate, mean_pulse_rate - overall_mean as excess_first FROM status_means CROSS JOIN overall_mean WHERE mean_pulse_rate > overall_mean), second_overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(mean_pulse_rate) as second_threshold FROM first_filtered), second_filtered AS (SELECT equipstatus, mean_pulse_rate, excess_first, mean_pulse_rate - second_threshold as excess_second FROM first_filtered CROSS JOIN second_overall_mean WHERE mean_pulse_rate > second_threshold) SELECT AVG(mean_pulse_rate) as final_mean_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_first) as avg_excess_first, AVG(excess_second) as avg_excess_second FROM second_filtered
b.raw: Join signals to their matching telescopes and drop unmatched; for each equipment status, calculate the mean pulse rate of signals detected by that status (each signal weighted equally, excluding nulls); filter to keep statuses with mean above the mean of all status-means and calculate their excess; from those kept, further filter to keep statuses with mean above the mean of the kept statuses and calculate their excess; return one row with three unrounded values: the mean pulse rate of the final-kept statuses, the average excess of those statuses over the first threshold, and the average excess of those statuses over the second threshold.
